findings.title: Raw SQLite handles exposed by Ledger.connect()/transaction() can drop append-only triggers
findings.reproduction: ledger.connect(); DROP TRIGGER ledger_events_no_update; DROP TRIGGER ledger_events_no_delete; then UPDATE/DELETE on ledger_events succeeded in an isolated temp database.
findings.invariant: Canonical ledger state must not be mutable by any caller.
findings.adjudication: Not a criterion failure: Ledger public API has no mutation method, DB triggers enforce append-only during normal use, and no adapter/UI/voice/retrieved-content module imports kernel state (architecture gate clean). Recommendation: restrict connect()/transaction() to kernel-internal use or add a schema-owner guard in a later hardening pass.
